description: In a fictional sci-fi world, alien beings known as "Hundred-Beak" intend to control the consciousness of all humanity. en:
In a fictional sci-fi world, alien beings known as "Hundred-Beak" intend to control the consciousness of all humanity. A young girl named Li Haila unites with a human force to resist the alien invasion, learns the mystery of her own origins, and ultimately thwarts the alien life form's plan, protecting the fate of humanity.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
